data.sub: India mein 85% log khud ka karobar shuru karna chahte hain, Gen-Z sabse aage.

chat.say: Office time par aana, ye Gen-Z wale sapne band karo!
Sir bas degree milne do, apna startup hi kholenge!

data.asar: Monday ki subah boss ka chehra dekhne se pehle startup ka khayal aana pakka hai.
data.caption:
Job se mann bhar gaya hai ya boss se pareshan ho? Ye update sirf aapke liye hai!

💼 Bharat ke 85% log ab khud ka business shuru karna chahte hain
🚀 Is race mein Gen-Z sabse aage nikal rahi hai
📉 9-to-5 ki naukri se ab youth ka bharosa uth raha hai

Ab toh lagta hai sabko apna CEO banna hai!

Save kar lo, baad mein kaam aayega jab khud ki dukan kholni ho!
